messages:
Ava: Huge shoutout to infra + support — that late-night rollback saved the enterprise demo. Can’t thank you enough! :raised_hands:
Miguel: Seriously, y’all were heroic. @Priya and @Sam stayed on the call the whole time. :clap:
Priya: Team effort — @Devon’s config tweak + @Bella’s logging fix made the difference. Not a single customer visible hiccup after rollback.
Sam: Quick note: I pushed a tiny routing guard so the bad flag won’t be picked up again. Will add to the postmortem in a bit.
Devon: Thanks! Shout to @eng-oncall (Sam) for spotting the anomaly in the heap graphs. Would’ve taken longer without that.
Bella: glad that helped. Also moved the flaky metric to warn-only for the next 24h to avoid alert spam.
deploy-bot: Automatic deploy rollback to v1.9.2 triggered by @Sam at 03:42 UTC — status: success.
Ava: Official kudos thread: I’m nominating Priya/Devon/Bella/Sam for the hero stickers + a team snack box. Please chime in if you want to be added.
Miguel: Add me to the sticker nomination please. Also ordering snacks: poll time — donuts or empanadas? :donut: :taco:
Priya: Donuts for me (but gluten-free pls).
Sam: Empanadas! savory wins my heart.
Devon: Donuts are universally good.
Bella: I’ll bring coffee either way.
Ava: Perfect — I’ll post a quick Slack poll in #random-polls and arrange the box. Again, huge thanks to everyone who jumped in, late hours and all. :sparkles: :heart:
Priya: Extra thanks to monitoring team for the rapid paging — that made triage way faster.
Miguel: Short and sweet: you folks are lifesavers. If anyone wants to add anything to the postmortem before I lock it, ping me.
Sam: I’ll add a short timeline + signal graphs in the doc by noon.
Devon: Added my config diff link in the doc.
Ava: Love it. Sending kudos thread to leadership for official recognition. :trophy:
